High-dimensional parameter flow cytometr.name_in_paper: High-dimensional parameter flow cytometric analysis of NK cell subsets
High-dimensional parameter flow cytometr.readouts: high-parameter NK cell marker expression profiles for maturation and functional markers

evidence.section: High-dimensional parameter flow cytometric analysis of NK cell subsets
evidence.quote: For high parameter analysis using the BD Symphony panels, 5x10 6 cells from each site were stained in 96 well v-bottom plates using an optimized antibody panel as described in the Key Resources Table .

In vitro cytokine stimulation and functi.name_in_paper: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
In vitro cytokine stimulation and functi.readouts: intracellular IFN-γ production after cytokine stimulation of sorted NK cells

evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: NK cells (CD45 + CD56 + CD3 − ) sorted from freshly processed tissue sites (see above) were cultured in 96-well u-bottom plates in RPMI-1640 medium containing fetal bovine serum (10%) with or without 10ng/ml IL-12 (PeproTech, cat# 200–12), 100ng/ml IL-15 (PeproTech, cat# 200–15) and 100ng/ml IL-18 (MBL International Corp.

measuring degranulation by NK cells.readouts: CD107a expression as a degranulation readout after co-culture with K562 cells

evidence.section: In vitro cytokine stimulation and functional assays of NK cells
evidence.quote: For measuring degranulation by NK cells, 30,000–50,000 sorted, overnight rested NK cells were incubated with K562 cells (ATCC: CCL-243; provided by Emily Mace, Columbia University) at a 2:1 effector to target (NK: K562) ratio in a 96-well tissue culture plate at 37°C at 5% CO 2 for 4 hours.

Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell.name_in_paper: Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell subsets
Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell.sample_type: sorted CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + natural killer cells

evidence.section: Whole transcriptome profiling of NK cell subsets
evidence.quote: RNA was isolated from sorted CD56 bright CD16 − and CD56 dim CD16 + NK cells using the RNA Easy kit (QIAGEN cat # 74004) and library preparation was done using the SMART-Seq® ultra-low input RNA kit (Takara bio).
